name: Duplicate Alert Check
creator: 3139d5f3-4dbb-44be-81dc-02207261b23c
description: Is this Alert the first in the Case?  Is it the first in the Case of this Alert type?  Or is it a duplication.  Example usage: this Block can be used when Alert Grouping is causing multiple ITSM tickets for the same case. Different paths output string that can be used in the parent playbook to check the verdict.
